notes: First-person narrative: «أنا سمعته من الذي» names Suhayl's speaker only as «الذي»; the text then names the man who narrated to him (عطاء بن يزيد), so the route is read as given; the Ibn Sufyan quote «قلت حدثنا عمرو، عن القعقاع، عن أبيك» is another transmitter for the same saying, kept as a variant group; the reading of the unnamed «الذي» needs a ruling
